fields.climate: tropical marine; generally warm and humid, moderated by northeast trade winds; dry season (January to June), rainy season (July to December); little seasonal temperature variation
fields.terrain: volcanic origin, surrounded by coral reefs; relatively flat coralline limestone plateau (source of most fresh water), with steep coastal cliffs and narrow coastal plains in north, low hills in center, mountains in south
fields.hazards: frequent squalls during rainy season; relatively rare but potentially destructive typhoons (June to December)
fields.farm: fruits, copra, vegetables; eggs, pork, poultry, beef
fields.exports: scrap iron, scrap copper, trunks and cases
fields.industries: national defense, tourism, construction, transshipment services, concrete products, printing and publishing, food processing, textiles
fields.languages: English 43.3%, Filipino 24.9%, Chamorro 16%, other Pacific Island languages 9.4%, Asian languages 6.5%
fields.religions: Christian (predominantly Roman Catholic) 94.2%, folk religions 1.5%, Buddhist 1.1%, other 1.6%, unaffiliated 1.7%

system.text: unincorporated organized territory of the US with local self-government…

fields.legal: common law modeled on US system; US federal laws apply
